build_SLatGaussianDecoder: build a SLatGaussianDecoder with resolution, model channels, and representation config for 3D Gaussian splatting
build_SLatGaussianDecoderTdfyWrapper: build a SLatGaussianDecoderTdfyWrapper that loads pretrained checkpoint weights from a safetensors or torch file
run_forward_SLatGaussianDecoder: run the forward pass of SLatGaussianDecoder on a sparse tensor to get Gaussian representations
test_to_representation: test the to_representation method to convert sparse tensor outputs into a list of Gaussian objects
review_calc_layout: review the _calc_layout method that computes output channel layout for xyz, features, scaling, rotation, and opacity
